AZ-PQC-001.description: Identify internet-facing services that depend on classical public-key cryptography, assess the lifetime of protected data, and include their TLS configurations in the organisation's PQC migration plan.

AZ-PQC-002.control_name: Prioritise migration of critical cryptographic keys
AZ-PQC-002.description: Inventory RSA and elliptic-curve keys, identify their system and supplier dependencies, and migrate keys protecting critical or long-lived data as a highest-priority activity.

AZ-PQC-003.control_name: Plan migration of public key infrastructure
AZ-PQC-003.description: Discover certificates and trust dependencies that rely on quantum-vulnerable signatures, then plan a staged migration that supports cryptographic agility and ecosystem readiness.
